Senses.PreferredTarget: there will be serious business ahead
AlternateTargets: there is still a major matter to face
Senses.Note: Four distinct warnings span four independent masters and works.

Occurrences.Kwic: 若明得此兩語，南泉落在下風；若明不得此兩語，大有事在。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J29/J29nB222.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Zishui of Wolong, Kuizhou. Zishui warns that anyone unable to understand the two raised sayings still has serious business ahead.

Occurrences.Kwic: 遮裏一一得個出身句，我與你分歲尚且大有事在。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J34/J34nB311.xml). Complete Record of Chan Master Juelangsheng of Tianjie. Juelang Daosheng says that even producing an escape line for each raised case leaves serious business before he will divide the year with the assembly.

Occurrences.Kwic: 諸人還承當得麼？若承當得，九十日夏也不虗度。脫或未然，前頭大有事在。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X70/X70n1386.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Shitian Faxun. Shitian Faxun warns that those unable to accept his instruction have serious business ahead.

Occurrences.Kwic: 今時人但言饑來吃飯、困來打眠，千休萬歇便爾承當，殊不知其中大有事在。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X72/X72n1437.xml). Expanded Record of Chan Master Yongjue Yuanxian. Yongjue Yuanxian rejects claims that eating when hungry and sleeping when tired settle everything, saying serious business remains within it.

Senses.Explanation: There is serious business ahead is a warning that failure to understand or premature claims of completion will have grave consequences. Chan masters place it directly after a failed test, an unresolved case, or an assertion that nothing remains to be done. Zishui warns those unable to understand two raised sayings; Juelang says that even producing escape lines for four cases leaves serious business; Shitian warns anyone unable to accept his summer instruction; and Yongjue rejects casual claims that eating and sleeping settle the matter.
